name: solar_geometry_sun_path
title: Solar geometry and sun path
summary: Solar geometry for a fixed site (Port-au-Prince, Haiti): day of year, declination, hour angle, incidence and zenith angles, solar altitude and azimuth, sunrise/sunset times; native file blocked by nDay_ and $ifnot parametrictable, runnable variant verified.

verification.reference: EES stored solution of solar/angles.EES (22 variables) compared with the runnable variant solar_geometry_sun_path_coolsolve.eescode
verification.notes: Variant vs EES: 22 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 0. Max 1.5e-6 on theta_z (trigonometric round-off); all others agree to at least 1e-7. No variable excluded.
